# XIAORAN MACHINERY — Drilling Rigs & Industrial Equipment Manufacturer

> XIAORAN MACHINERY is a manufacturer and global supplier of exploration drilling rigs, water well drilling rigs, skid steer loaders, spider cranes and aerial work platforms, based in Jining, Shandong, China. The company exports worldwide and supports buyers with written configuration proposals, container packing for shipment and pre-order technical consultation. Sales contact: sales@xiaoranmachinery.cn.

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/about/): company profile, manufacturing capability and export experience.
- [Customer Visits](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/customer-visits/): photos of international buyers visiting the Jining factory to inspect machines before ordering.
- [Shipment Examples](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/shipment-examples/): container packing and export shipment documentation of machines delivered to customers.

## Products

- [Exploration Drilling Rigs](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/exploration-drilling-rigs/): wireline core rigs for mineral exploration; NTW/BTW/HTW depth ratings from 200 m to 1500 m (models FDX200, FDX400, FDX600, FD800–FD1500).
- [Water Well Drilling Rigs](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/water-well-drilling-rigs/): DTH and mud rotary rigs for household, farm, irrigation and geothermal wells (models FY300A–FY500, XZ03B/XZ03C/XZ05A).
- [Skid Steer Loaders](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/skid-steer-loaders/): wheeled and tracked loaders with rated operating capacity from 700 kg to 1200 kg (models C1200, V1000, T480, S360).
- [Spider Cranes](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/spider-cranes/): compact crawler cranes for indoor and confined-space lifting, 3–12 t models (GTJZ04, GTJZ10, GTJZ12).
- [Aerial Work Platforms](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/products/aerial-work-platforms/): electric scissor lifts and crawler platforms for indoor and outdoor work at height.

## Buying Guides (Insights)

- [How to Choose an Exploration Drilling Rig](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/insights/choose-exploration-drilling-rig/): depth, core size, terrain and power considerations.
- [NTW vs BTW vs HTW Drilling Depth Explained](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/insights/ntw-btw-htw-drilling-depth/): why depth ratings differ by core-barrel size.
- [300 m Water Well Rig Selection](https://www.xiaoranmachinery.cn/insights/): air versus mud rotary method comparison.
